title: Cartwise Shopper Payouts Instant Cashout Fee and Limit Tariff
content:
Tariff of on-demand (instant) cashouts for every Cartwise Shopper Payouts plan. Amounts are in US dollars; a day means a calendar day.

## Tariff table — availability, fee and speed

| Plan | Instant cashouts offered | Fee per instant cashout (USD) | Fee taken on top of the amount sent | First instant cashout after verification free | Promised arrival (minutes) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | No | 0.00 | Yes | No | 0 (no instant cashout) |
| Instant Cashout | Yes | 0.50 | Yes | Yes | 30 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | No | 1 |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | No | 1 |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | No | 1 |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | Yes | 0.00 | Yes | No | 1 |

## Tariff table — amount limits and holds

| Plan | Cashouts per calendar day | Smallest cashout (USD) | Largest single cashout (USD) | Total cashouts per calendar day (USD) | New-account hold after verification (calendar days) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Weekly Direct Deposit | 0 (none) | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0.00 | 0 |
| Instant Cashout | 1 | 1.00 | 500.00 | 500.00 | 7 |
| Everyday Pay Card Blue | 5 | 1.00 | 500.00 | 1000.00 | 7 |
| Everyday Pay Card Gold | 5 | 1.00 | 750.00 | 1500.00 | 3 |
| Everyday Pay Card Platinum | 5 | 1.00 | 1000.00 | 2000.00 | 3 |
| Everyday Pay Card Diamond | 5 | 1.00 | 1000.00 | 3000.00 | 0 |

## Settings common to every plan

| Setting | Every plan |
|---|---|
| Any cashout allowed while the payout account is frozen | No |
| Tip credits become cashable only once their batch is finalized | Yes |

## Notes to the tariff

1. "Fee taken on top" means the fee is taken from the balance in addition to the amount sent, rather than deducted from the amount sent. Hypothetical illustration: on Instant Cashout a cashout of 40.00 sends 40.00 to the debit card and takes 40.50 in total from the balance (the 40.00 sent together with the 0.50 fee).
2. The per-day count and the per-day total are counted over one calendar day. A count of 0 on Weekly Direct Deposit means the plan offers no on-demand cashout.
3. The new-account hold is a count of calendar days after the verification date of the payout account.
4. The first-cashout waiver column applies only to the first instant cashout after verification; on Instant Cashout that cashout carries a fee of 0.00 and later cashouts carry 0.50.
